facts.claim: Kentucky Tourism lists patio dining and describes the patio as heated in winter. Confirm seasonal opening, heating and the route before visiting; this does not establish step-free patio access.
facts.quote: Patio dining (heated in the winter) is available.

facts.claim: Olla offers delivery and carryout ordering links. Its site says a 5% fee applies to to-go orders for compostable packaging; collection arrangements and any other charges need checking with the selected order.
quote: Order Delivery or Carry Out Below
we’ve switched to compostable carryout packaging.
A 5% fee is applied to to-go orders to help offset the higher cost of these sustainable containers.

facts.claim: The restaurant lists (859) 261-6552 for questions. Posted hours are 11 a.m.–11 p.m. Thursday–Saturday and 11 a.m.–8:45 p.m. Sunday, Tuesday and Wednesday; the displayed schedule does not list Monday. Confirm before travelling.
